dog.description_text:
Meet Atmosphere (Susie) – the sweetest girl and dream dog! @SusieQ_theRescue
Atmosphere is an incredible dog who loves everyones attention. She's a great walker who LOVES being outside—and gets so excited when anyone stops to say hello. She wants to be by your side or in your lap, but is perfect when left alone and can easily entertain herself with her toys—the perfect mix of snuggly couch potato and healthy pup. Her favorite toy is her kong or anything she can take stuffing out of. Training is a breeze because she is quite food motivated—and extremely gentle taking food and treats. She's fully house trained, sleeps on her dog bed through the night, and won't chew anything she's not supposed to. While she is best friends with our dog (and would like to be friends with our cat if he would allow it) she can be leash selective and would do best with a slow intro to other pets or a home with no other pets. She's very smart, super goofy, and deserves all the love in the world!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
